attempt: Ship Adaptive Window 0.4.7-rc.1 transition meshes after server-side geometry and reload checks
reason_failed: The Hytale 0.7.4 client rejected the generated transition models because textureLayout offsets were serialized as decimals where its model parser requires Int32. The user also observed floating fringes and duplicate transitions in the installed rc.1.
error_signature: System.Text.Json.JsonException at shape.textureLayout.front.offset.x; 12,217 client warnings across 2,568 transition model paths
conditions: Server asset registration did not exercise the client's blockymodel JSON parser
Independent reciprocal contact generation could draw both directions
Previous pose used entity pitch/roll with an unverified renderer pivot assumption
workaround: Use 0.4.7-rc.2: integer UV offsets and quad dimensions with geometric stretch, baked mesh face orientation and yaw-only entity pose, one ordered direction per contact, and frame-supported extension limited to opaque geometry.

source_refs.description: Bounded private log and image evidence for rc.1; hashes and error count
Root cause, implementation and regression account
